meta.note: Canonical channel bouquet. status: poc = live on the asiko.africa POC now; interested = signed interest / on the bouquet deck; queued = onboarding queue, genre inferred from name, synopsis pending. logo paths are relative to the asiko.live site root (assets/img/channels/).

channels.name: Asiko TV
channels.synopsis: The master channel of the Asiko bouquet — a 24/7 simulcast reel of the best of Nollywood, news, music, faith and culture drawn from every channel on the platform. Built to be the first thing a new viewer finds, and the reason they stay to explore the rest.

channels.name: Asiko+
channels.synopsis: The curated, ad-light extension of Asiko TV — binge blocks, exclusive premieres and diaspora-first specials pulled from across the bouquet, for viewers who want more of Asiko TV's best on their own time.

channels.name: Movie Africa
channels.synopsis: Entertainment done right — everything Movies. Stories from an African perspective; our stories, our movies, Nollywood, Gollywood and all the other 'woods' across the continent.

channels.name: Movie Africa International
channels.synopsis: The international extension of Movie Africa — entertainment done right, carrying African stories and movies to audiences beyond the continent.

channels.name: Movie Africa: Epic
channels.synopsis: The period-drama arm of the Movie Africa family — kingdoms, warriors and legends brought to life in sweeping historical epics rooted in African history and folklore.

channels.name: Movie Africa: Yoruba
channels.synopsis: Yoruba-language cinema at its finest — from classic epics to contemporary drama, spotlighting the stars and stories that built the Yoruba film industry.

channels.name: Movie Africa: Originals
channels.synopsis: First-run, exclusive Nollywood productions commissioned for the Movie Africa family — fresh stories audiences won't find anywhere else.

channels.name: Movie Africa: Igbo
channels.synopsis: The definitive home of Igbo-language cinema — from the golden age of Nollywood East to today's rising storytellers.

channels.name: Movie Africa: Halisa
channels.synopsis: Hausa-language cinema from Kano and beyond — Kannywood's biggest stars and stories for Northern Nigeria and the wider Hausa-speaking world.

channels.name: Movie Africa: African Stories
channels.synopsis: Beyond Nigeria — feature films and series from across the continent, widening the Movie Africa family into a true pan-African cinema library.

channels.name: Sinema Olopin
channels.synopsis: A most contemporary Yoruba TV channel that is much more than movies and talk shows — Yoruba culture laid bare in all its beauty, subtitled in English.

channels.name: Movie India
channels.synopsis: Bollywood movies have long been a staple on the Nigerian and African movie menu. Follow the best and latest of the Bollywood blockbusters.

channels.name: Key TV
channels.synopsis: African Stories — series, movies, documentaries and culture, unlocking the continent's stories one key at a time.

channels.name: Ozola TV
channels.synopsis: The channel of veteran Nollywood director-producer Zeb Ejiro — decades of Nigerian film and television storytelling under one roof.

channels.name: MAB Magicbox
channels.synopsis: African street movies paired with music programming — grassroots Nollywood storytelling and the soundtrack that goes with it.

channels.name: Amen Movies
channels.synopsis: The Christian movie genre is fast developing and catering for the Christian community in Nigeria and around the world. Amen Movies is the definitive Christian Movies channel.

channels.name: Amen Yoruba
channels.synopsis: Worship is a key part of Yoruba culture; this channel defines and chronicles the Yoruba gospel journey for millions of Yoruba-speaking believers.

channels.name: PPG
channels.synopsis: Unleash the awesome power of the Almighty God as He inhabits our praises — Africa's premiere praise and worship channel, nonstop, to Him who deserves it.

channels.name: Sultana
channels.synopsis: The home of the Cherubim and Seraphim movement — worship, teaching and testimony for one of Africa's oldest indigenous church traditions.

channels.name: Grace Embassy TV
channels.synopsis: Ministry programming, worship and teaching from Grace Embassy — sermons, testimonies and church life for the faith community it serves.

channels.name: X2D TV
channels.synopsis: A Christian channel bringing worship, teaching and ministry programming to the Asiko faith shelf.

channels.name: Mandate News International
channels.synopsis: Independent, mandate-driven news coverage of Nigeria, Africa and the world — politics, business and the stories that matter, reported straight.

channels.name: GoldMyne TV
channels.synopsis: Nigeria's entertainment industry, mined for gold — celebrity news, red-carpet coverage and the stories behind the stars.

channels.name: City People TV
channels.synopsis: Lagos high society and beyond — celebrity news, parties and the social scene, brought to television.

channels.name: FAD360
channels.synopsis: A 360-degree look at the stories of the day across Africa — reported straight, from politics to the culture desk.

channels.name: C-Suite Cafe
channels.synopsis: Conversations from the executive suite — CEOs, founders and industry leaders unpacking strategy, leadership and the business of getting to the top.

channels.name: Business Day TV
channels.synopsis: Markets, macroeconomics and the deals shaping Nigeria's economy — business news and analysis for investors, entrepreneurs and policy watchers.

channels.name: Estates TV
channels.synopsis: Lifestyle, business and legacy — property listings, real estate investment advice and the developments shaping Africa's skylines.

channels.name: Laffo TV
channels.synopsis: A wholly indigenous African comedy channel. Watch out for the kings and stars of African comedy, back to back.

channels.name: Nite of a Thousand Laughs
channels.synopsis: The broadcast home of Opa Williams' iconic Nigerian stand-up comedy franchise — a second flagship for Asiko's Comedy shelf alongside Laffo TV.

channels.name: QuesTV
channels.synopsis: Africa's premier fashion, beauty and style television lifestyle channel — speaking only the language of style, unmatched in covering the industry across the continent.

channels.name: Shakara
channels.synopsis: Style in the spirit of the mother continent — a dedicated African and Afrocentric fashion channel, formerly Quest TV, the first-ever 24-hour African fashion channel.

channels.name: Sisi TV
channels.synopsis: A glamour and lifestyle channel for the modern African woman — beauty, style and the everyday glow-up, told with confidence and flair.

channels.name: Hooked
channels.synopsis: Power to the couple. Weddings are the centrepiece of African celebration — Hooked follows the greatest love stories and the businesses built around them, on Africa's premiere wedding channel.

channels.name: GhanaWeds
channels.synopsis: Ghana's dedicated wedding channel — real ceremonies, vendors and love stories from the Ghanaian wedding industry, extending Asiko's wedding shelf beyond Nigeria.

channels.name: Bounce
channels.synopsis: Little treasures for your little treasure — an exclusive kiddies channel of cartoons, animations and excursions following the adventures of the Nigerian kid.

channels.name: CKS TV (Charmingkids)
channels.synopsis: The broadcast home of Charmingkids — grooming, talent development and confidence-building programming for the next generation of African children.

channels.name: Teen Africa
channels.synopsis: Made by and for African teens — school life, trends, music and the issues that matter to the continent's next generation.

channels.name: Platinum Play
channels.synopsis: When a CD goes platinum, it's a commercial blockbuster. This urban contemporary music channel follows the hip-hop artistes and dancehall anthems raving across Africa.

channels.name: Play
channels.synopsis: Nigerian music is massive around the world; Play delivers the best of Nigerian and African music — fresh, contemporary and retro — plus the whole lifestyle around the beat.

channels.name: PMAN TV
channels.synopsis: The official voice of the Performing Musicians Association of Nigeria — industry news, artiste development and the business side of African music.

channels.name: Star Throne TV
channels.synopsis: A music reality and talent-show channel — the search for Africa's next star, competition format front and centre.

channels.name: Ooginee
channels.synopsis: There has never been a popular, correctly-done television channel in the Igbo language — Ooginee is a uniquely crafted explosion into the life and times of the Igbo nation.

channels.name: Heritage TV
channels.synopsis: Africa's history, traditions and heritage — documentaries and storytelling that preserve and celebrate the continent's cultural memory.

channels.name: Arewa24
channels.synopsis: General entertainment for Northern Nigeria and the Hausa-speaking world — drama, music and lifestyle programming rooted in Arewa culture.

channels.name: NDTV
channels.synopsis: Nigeria's first real digital pay-TV platform for the Niger Delta — the next largest homogenous block after the three major nations — chronicling its stories and struggles.

channels.name: OGN TV
channels.synopsis: Igbo Culture Television — language, tradition and everyday life from the Igbo nation, told in Igbo.

channels.name: EKS TV (Edo Kulture Streams)
channels.synopsis: The Edo State pilot of Kulture Streams — a content competition and streaming showcase built around Edo language and culture.

channels.name: Kulture Streams
channels.synopsis: "Nollywood in Your Tongue" — an AI-powered pan-African content competition and streaming platform surfacing local-language film, music and voice talent.

channels.name: Africa Celebrates TV
channels.synopsis: The broadcast home of the Africa Celebrates event series — festivals, ceremonies and cultural celebration from across the continent.

channels.name: TWC (The Woman Channel)
channels.synopsis: The African woman is a unique breed — a beast of labour and love. TWC follows her stories through love, family, triumph and every fabled strength she carries.

channels.name: Women Connect TV
channels.synopsis: Connecting African women in business, leadership and community — networking, mentorship and empowerment programming for women on the rise.

channels.name: Yotomi
channels.synopsis: A future-forward channel designed to propagate and elevate Yoruba values, ideas and ways of life — pioneering community broadcasting for national unity and progress.

channels.name: BEN — Bridging The Gap
channels.synopsis: Bridging the gap between government, business and everyday citizens — current affairs and community dialogue on the issues that divide and unite us.

channels.name: Ability TV
channels.synopsis: Just as able — a channel dedicated to disability advocacy, accessibility and the achievements of people living with disabilities across Africa.

channels.name: CompassionTV
channels.synopsis: Stories of compassion in action — charity drives, humanitarian work and the everyday Africans giving back to their communities.

channels.name: Tattase
channels.synopsis: A pioneering Afrocentric digital multimedia platform focused on celebrating and promoting African cultures, cuisines, recipes, food brands and tourism — the flagship of the original Tattase TV lineup, now part of the Asiko bouquet.

channels.name: Ashakata
channels.synopsis: The definitive contemporary Hausa lifestyle channel, catering for millions of Hausa-speaking people across the length and breadth of Africa.

channels.name: Naija
channels.synopsis: A wholly and fully Nigerian lifestyle channel featuring everything that defines Nigeria — the lingo, the food, the news, the challenges.

channels.name: JustU TV
channels.synopsis: Just you — a self-improvement and lifestyle channel on mindset, wellness and everyday personal growth for the modern African.

channels.name: Goge Africa
channels.synopsis: Africa's farms, farmers and food systems — agribusiness, rural life and the people feeding the continent, one harvest at a time.

channels.name: Diaspora TV
channels.synopsis: "The African pulse worldwide" — news, culture and connection programming for Africans living abroad.

channels.name: Foodies & Spices
channels.synopsis: Food, travel and lifestyle — recipes, spice trails and dining culture from across Africa.

channels.name: KilarigboTV
channels.synopsis: A Yoruba-language lifestyle channel — everyday culture, style and living for the Yoruba-speaking audience.

channels.name: The Cowrie
channels.synopsis: A dedicated shopping channel spotlighting Micro, Small and Medium enterprises across Africa — driven by food, fashion, agriculture and lifestyle content that sells.

channels.name: BUY TV
channels.synopsis: Africa's television shopping destination — products, deals and live demos bringing e-commerce straight into the living room.

channels.name: 1MATV (One Market Africa TV)
channels.synopsis: The definitive pan-African digital shopping platform — one market, one continent, connecting buyers and sellers across Africa.

channels.name: Travel Nigeria
channels.synopsis: The safari. Nigeria is a vast, travel-friendly nation — this channel presents it as the next big travel destination, the definitive guide for business and leisure travellers alike.

channels.name: ATQ TV
channels.synopsis: Destinations, journeys and travel culture across Africa — Asiko's second Travel & Tourism voice alongside Travel Nigeria.

channels.name: Sportsville TV
channels.synopsis: A brand-new general sports channel — scores, highlights and sports culture across the games Africa follows.

channels.name: Striker
channels.synopsis: Strictly football — news, transfers and match analysis for a channel built by and for the game's die-hards.

channels.name: Spires TV
channels.synopsis: The spirit of Naija street football — grassroots pitches, local heroes and the raw, unscripted game as it's really played.

channels.name: TNT Television
channels.synopsis: Natively modern — a general entertainment channel blending African roots with contemporary programming for today's viewer.

channels.name: Cons TV
channels.synopsis: The home of legends — profiling the icons, trailblazers and larger-than-life personalities who have shaped African entertainment, business and culture.

channels.name: Miss Hotlegs TV
channels.synopsis: Beauty, glamour and competition — behind-the-scenes access to the Miss Hotlegs pageant and the queens who own the runway.

channels.name: R2TV
channels.synopsis: A general-interest entertainment channel — broad programming for the everyday African viewer.

channels.name: WAP TV
channels.synopsis: A general interest entertainment channel — broad, everyday programming under the WAP TV banner.

channels.name: Itage TV
channels.synopsis: Centre stage — theatre, spoken word and the performing arts, spotlighting Africa's stage actors, playwrights and directors.

channels.name: NoteBook
channels.synopsis: The education and skills channel — tutorials, skills and schools all re-defined right in your living room and bedroom.
